thread:
Emma (Head of Product): thanks everyone for the quick all-hands — wanted to surface the customer win/loss themes and take live Qs. i'll summarize the top 3 why-we-won / why-we-lost and then open to q&a.
Raj (Sales): quick note — for lost deals last quarter, price + compliance were top. also a few dropped because of latency on long prompts.
Sophia (CS): +1 on latency. two customers switched because model hallucinations on fine-tuned prompts. they needed reproducible evals.
David (CEO): thanks. can you give concrete examples we can act on? prioritization from leadership will depend on specifics.
Lin (Eng PM): example: AcmeHealth left citing inability to host in their VPC and latency spikes when using dedicated capacity during peak hours. they wanted a predictable 200ms p95.
Maria (Applied ML): on hallucinations — both customers were using instruction-following flows with slot-filling. failing cases were when we moved to 8k context and didn't lock quantization profile; generated off-by-one ids. fix = add regression test + pin quantization for that model family.
Ben (Customer Success): top asks from customers: 1) private/VPC quickstart (1-week path) 2) stronger SLAs for dedicated 3) clearer guidance on batching/quantization tradeoffs 4) prompt/eval kits to reproduce regressions.
Raj (Sales): also hearing demand for usage caps and auto-fallback to smaller models when committed capacity is exhausted. customers want predictable bill spikes.
Emma (Head of Product): ok, leadership — are we able to commit to a public roadmap item for 1-week private/VPC quickstart? that would unblock several deals.
David (CEO): we can commit to a milestone: "VPC quickstart beta" by end of Q2 if eng + security agree on scope. need a minimal checklist.
Lin (Eng PM): proposed checklist in short: 1) VPC connector docs + terraform module, 2) onboarding script for customer infra, 3) default KMS integration examples, 4) support runbook for common failures. estimate: 6 sprint-weeks of focused work.
Sophia (CS): for the SLA ask — can we offer latency tiers (standard / premium) with guaranteed p95 and fallback policies? customers would pay for premium.
David (CEO): yes, pricing tiers tied to latency SLAs seems reasonable. need input from finance on cost models.
Maria (Applied ML): i'll prioritize a small eval suite for the slot-filling regression and add it to the model onboarding checklist. will need 1-2 devs to help add automation.
Ben (Customer Success): action for us: i'll aggregate the exact customer language for the quickstart doc and share a template of asks so product can reuse.
Raj (Sales): Q for leadership: can we accelerate dedicated capacity SLAs? some prospects require contractual uptime for specific endpoints.
David (CEO): yes we should define a contract template. ops + legal to draft. priority = high.
Emma (Head of Product): can someone own owner the "why-we-lost" playbook? I propose Ben + Raj + Lin draft a short playbook that maps loss reasons to mitigations (e.g., pricing, latency, private deployment, model quality).
Ben (Customer Success): happy to own it, will spin up a doc.
Lin (Eng PM): i'll contribute deployment/latency mitigations and the proposed engineering timelines.
Raj (Sales): i'll add the deal signal examples and priority weighting.
allhands-bot: :spiral_calendar: action added: create "lose-playbook" doc in Confluence. owner: Ben. due: 2 weeks.
Sophia (CS): small ask — can we get a public short FAQ on quantization/batching effects? customers get surprised by accuracy shifts.
Maria (Applied ML): yes — i can write a 1-pager with examples + recommended profiles.
David (CEO): final ask from me: leadership will review a one-page summary of proposed commitments (VPC quickstart beta, latency SLA tiers, loss-playbook, eval suite) by next Wed. emma, please schedule follow-up.
Emma (Head of Product): will do. i'll post slides + meeting notes here: https://redwoodhq.internal/allhands/1932004567-notes and will tag owners. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Raj (Sales): thanks — great discussion.
Ben (Customer Success): tagging follow-ups: @Emma @Lin @Maria @David.
Sophia (CS): +1.
Lin (Eng PM): i'll add a PR to the roadmap doc with the Q2 milestones tonight.
Maria (Applied ML): leaving a small note: we should include a regression alert on the console for top N prompts — might reduce surprise churn.
David (CEO): good idea, add it to the one-pager.
Emma (Head of Product): last note — please keep replies concise; i'll convert this thread into tickets after the follow-up meeting. thanks everyone!
